verdict.rationale: Zapier's public REST APIs carry versioned paths such as /trigger-inbox/v1 and v1/v2 Workflow API endpoints, and they are backed by published OpenAPI specs. The documented deprecation lifecycle (legacy, deprecating, deprecated) covers partner integration versions only, not Zapier's own public APIs, so it does not count toward this story. missing for 10: a documented deprecation/stability policy for Zapier's public APIs, sunset timelines or deprecation headers, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Zapier's own public REST APIs, which carry versioned paths (/trigger-inbox/v1, v1/v2 Workflow API endpoints)
